lineage: S103 lost under every cost tier. S104 tests the user's specific diagnosis that an FVG reaction extreme is not a valid stop anchor unless it first sweeps observable prior liquidity. No other signal or confluence rule is intentionally changed.

unchanged_from_s103.formation: Displaced 1h three-candle FVG: body >= 0.80 ATR14, volume >= 1.15 prior 20-bar median, gap 0.05 to 1.25 ATR.
unchanged_from_s103.decision_tree: Closed 15m defense or close-through, retest and IFVG rejection; later break within three bars; next-5m-open entry.
unchanged_from_s103.macro: Long only in S101 UP, short only in S101 DOWN, plus aligned closed-bar 4h EMA50 trend.
unchanged_from_s103.micro: At least two of OI expansion, directional taker flow and relative-volume confirmation.
unchanged_from_s103.target_and_time: 2.5R from actual fill; maximum holding time 720 minutes.
unchanged_from_s103.portfolio: One global position; $0.50 risk cap; 0.2% equity risk; 75% notional cap; leverage <= 5.

single_tested_change.liquidity_reference: Highest high / lowest low of the 20 fully closed preceding 15m candles, excluding the current candle.
single_tested_change.long_sweep: Reaction low must penetrate the prior liquidity low by at least 0.02 ATR15 and the candle must close back above that level.
single_tested_change.short_sweep: Reaction high must penetrate the prior liquidity high by at least 0.02 ATR15 and the candle must close back below that level.
single_tested_change.defense: The touch-to-reclaim sequence must contain a sweep in the intended trade direction.
single_tested_change.ifvg: The first retest/rejection candle must itself sweep liquidity in the intended inverted direction.
single_tested_change.stop: Exactly beyond the sweep extreme by 0.15 ATR15. Never substitute the FVG edge, generic touch extreme or an artificially widened minimum stop.
single_tested_change.admission: Skip the trade when the exact structural stop is closer than 0.50 ATR15 or farther than 4.0 ATR15 at the decision close.

data.source: The checksum-verified Binance archive frozen for S103; no new symbols or dates.
data.contamination: All history is contaminated by the prior S103 result. It may falsify S104 but cannot validate live profitability.

historical_gate.full_stress: At least 20 fills, positive PnL, PF > 1.05 and max drawdown <= 10%.
historical_gate.validation: At least 6 fills and positive stress PnL.
historical_gate.breadth: Both routes trade at least three times, both directions trade, neither direction loses under stress, and at least two symbols trade.
historical_gate.robustness: Severe PnL positive; at least two of three leave-one-out runs positive; bootstrap p10 positive.

decision_policy.historical: Failure rejects the hypothesis. A pass only authorizes a new paper-forward clock.
